<description>
These changes make IPC features work on windows, resolving https://github.com/bitcoin-core/libmultiprocess/issues/53 and https://github.com/bitcoin-core/libmultiprocess/issues/114

This is a draft because it is based on https://github.com/bitcoin-core/libmultiprocess/pull/231,  https://github.com/bitcoin-core/libmultiprocess/pull/317,  https://github.com/bitcoin-core/libmultiprocess/pull/318.

---
